-- Quest #15 / Scene #4 - Function scenario_tuto2_1
function scenario_tuto2_1()
	SetTransitionType(0)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(0)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("")
	MoveCamera(0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	RotCamera(0.00, 1.57, 100.00)


	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()


	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(scenario_tuto2_1)
